picks.why: Anthropic's S-1 puts payroll at about $107K per employee per month - a first look at what the labor bill of a frontier lab really is before public investors pile in.
The first outside replication of Anthropic's 'Teaching Claude Why' on open models: alignment techniques shipped in production can now be verified without frontier-lab access.
Binance's account of the $6B theft: months of fake dev tools and fake recruiters, then a pivot through internal AI tools to the wallet authorization system.
Nine engineers merged 1,211 PRs in a day while migrating a live service from Python to Rust - the constraint is now specs and review, not code.
ChatGPT went from 1B to 1.2B weekly users in 60 days and says search-like queries are about a fifth of Google's - company numbers, but the pace is the news.
